mapper.select: SELECT ItemCode, SaleYn, SupplyQty, OptionPrice, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' / ', NULLIF(AttrVal1, ''), NULLIF(AttrVal2, ''), NULLIF(AttrVal3, ''), NULLIF(AttrVal4, '')), '') AS itemName FROM shopion.tPrdProdItem WHERE ProdCode = #{prodCode} AND ItemCode = #{itemCode}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tPrdProdItem WHERE ProdCode = #{prodCode} AND ItemCode <> '20000'
